scares.description: A vision of Megans burnt son is standing right next to her after repeatedly saying "Mom" accompanied with a loud sound.
When pastor Rizzo is turning around to collect more firewood Ricky is standing right in front of him (accompanied with stinger sound).
Big spider is appearing in the cone of light with a shriek.
The big spider is attacking Megan from behind when she says "See you on the other side".
